proposed_comments.title: Unregister the enabled-module callback

confidence.rationale: The pinned singleton, current settings object, strong Action field, and missing cleanup are directly visible. The single callback slot bounds the retained instances, and no memory profile or local runtime reproduction was run.

proposed_comments.body:
### Unregister the enabled-module callback

**Severity:** `medium`

`SettingsRepository<GeneralSettings>` is process-wide and retains its current settings object; `EnabledModules` stores this callback in a strong, single-slot `Action` field. When navigation disposes the dashboard's `QuickAccessViewModel`, the callback remains registered and keeps that disposed view model (including its quick-access items and launcher state) alive while the app stays on another page. A subsequent Home visit replaces the callback, so this is bounded retention rather than per-visit accumulation; please add a matching removal API in `GeneralSettings`/`EnabledModules` and unregister this delegate in `Dispose`, clearing it only if it still matches this instance.
